notes.title: Announcing The Hearth & Harbour, a restaurant management RPG
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="VlnoUCO3nRQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey regulars, we’ve got something special cooking! Today we’re thrilled to share that Saltstone Studios, the team behind [i]The Pale Beyond[/i], is back with a brand new game for PC, [url="https://bit.ly/HearthHarbourSteam"][u][i]The Hearth & Harbour[/i][/u][/url].[/p][p]
[i]The Hearth & Harbour[/i] is an adventure management RPG set in the same world and time as [i]The Pale Beyond[/i]. This time, the ice has melted into salt air as you step into the seaside town of Lewthport, ready to begin a new life. Your task? Restore the rundown local restaurant, The Silver Spoon, and decide what kind of manager (and neighbor) you’ll become.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41484940/3a88f24a6c65b0cce8ebb8e47c90cca058fd946d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At the heart of [i]The Hearth & Harbour[/i] lies more than just recipes and renovations. As an immigrant finding your place in a tight-knit town on the brink of war, the restaurant becomes your link to the community.[/p][p][/p][p]The Silver Spoon isn’t just where you’ll serve food, it’s where you’ll shape relationships. The menu you craft depends on the connections you build with Lewthport’s townsfolk and, in turn, the dishes you serve will influence who walks through your door. Each decision, from ingredients to décor to staffing, opens new bonds, storylines, and possibilities.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41484940/e87f5d99c62b5757e8dde793c9798e499a5c6f29.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Do you want The Silver Spoon to become a bustling bistro or a greasy local haunt? Will you invest in cozy décor and fresh produce, or cut corners to keep your books balanced? When service begins, you’ll juggle it all through turn-based tactical gameplay that challenges you to satisfy customers, support staff, and keep the business afloat.[/p][p][/p][p]Every choice ripples outward, not just shaping the restaurant, but also the lives of Lewthport’s people and the story of the city itself.[/p][list][*][p][b]Adventure management strategy[/b]: balancing décor, staffing, menus, and service[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character-driven storytelling[/b]: build relationships and unlock branching story arcs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customization[/b]: design the restaurant of your dreams, from cozy corners to lively tavern tables[/p][/*][*][p][b]A daily cycle[/b]: mornings to prepare, afternoons to run the restaurant, and evenings to connect with locals[/p][/*][/list][p]
We can’t wait for you to step into Lewthport and take your seat at our table. Wishlist [i]The Hearth & Harbour[/i] now on [url="https://bit.ly/HearthHarbourSteam"][u]Steam[/u][/url], and follow Fellow Traveller on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/fellowtraveller.games"][u]Bluesky[/u][/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@fellowtravellergames"][u]TikTok[/u][/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/fellowtravellergames"][u]Instagram[/u][/url], [url="https://www.threads.net/@fellowtravellergames"][u]Threads[/u][/url], or jump into our [url="http://bit.ly/FellowTravellerDiscord"][u]official Fellow Traveller Discord[/u][/url] to become a regular at The Silver Spoon from day one.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528170/The_Hearth_and_Harbour/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, 
New smaller patch that includes:
- Full 21:9 widescreen support, including expanded artwork for all game backgrounds. 
- Additional minor fixes. 

We're currently doing private testing on the new difficulty modes we have in the works, and continuing with development of the expanded ending epilogues, cut content, and auto-save experiments. 

If you're interested in joining the private beta testing you can reach out to us on discord, or wait until we roll out the public testing branch here. 

Thanks for the continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, smaller round of fixes in anticipation of the next larger updates!

- Fixed issue rewinding back to week 1 reverting the stowaway choice. 
- Fixed issue with interview and medbay healing priority ordering. 
- Fixed fact badge popups being cut off screen on smaller resolutions (including steamdeck) 
- Fixed choice spacing, and dialogue lines being cut off on smaller resolutions.
- Fixed ending the week underdeck on the temperance causing camera issues. 
- Fixed [spoiler]Leopard Seal[/spoiler] attack balancing issue.
- Fixed some manifest card UX issues when playing with mouse and keyboard at the same time. 
- Fixed issue with emote staging delays when holding Ctrl to skip dialogue.
- Fixed issue using Medical Comforts on shore camp. 
- Various minor visual fixes. 

Widescreen support, balancing updates and expanded epilogues are currently undergoing internal testing before being rolled out next! Thanks again, for the continued feedback and reporting!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, 
We're wrapping up some quick rounds of smaller reported issues before rolling out the next larger 1.4.0.0 update.

[h1]1.3.1.0 Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed loading saves from the map screen resulting in some visual glitches.
- Fixed Cordell ending dissonance bugs.
- Fixes to late game character emotes.
- Fixed issue with Stowaway choice being reverted when loading back to week 1 of the expedition after having completed the game.
- Additional Crew Manifest card fixes.
- Fixes to controller/keyboard input, including choice selection desync.
- Fixed visible player cabin on the ice.
- Auto Save in week 3 moved to the first line of the week.
- Fix to corrupted settings.config files preventing game start.
- Rationing slider selection now auto default to what you can afford that week, if you can’t afford Normal rations.
- Mr. Glossly is now understandably sad if you [spoiler]interrupt his report by killing the entire penguin colony.[/spoiler]
- Repositioned Grimley’s evening conversation location in first camp to make controller/keyboard selection smoother.
- Various typo and grammar & ludonarrative fixes.
- Various minor visual fixes.
- Various minor technical fixes.

[h1]Next up![/h1]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0.0 - Updated Save System
notes.notes:
We’ve updated how the save system works, based on player feedback and observed play to reduce the amount of replay time needed on first time runs. 

- All save files are now permanently unlocked and accessible.
- Reverting to an earlier save file on a line will rewind progress on that line line back to that save file.
- Spoiler: [spoiler]Going to an earlier save file on a stained line, having eaten the fruit, will instead branch out into a new line without rewinding the line.[/spoiler]
- You can still manually delete and prune saves using the tree.
- The Left Ctrl button (PC/Mac) and Circle/B on controller can be held down to quickly skip through dialogue without accidently choosing choices
- Existing save tree structures will still exist, no existing saves will be deleted from updating the game to the new behaviour.
- Variety of smaller bug and script fixes.

If anyone has any bugged saves that are preventing them from progressing further with the game, don’t be afraid to get in touch with us on Discord [https://discord.gg/eCYNEmw8](https://discord.gg/eCYNEmw8) and we can look at your saves directly.  

We’ll be continuing to support the game with additional updates and fixes. 
The next big update in the works is full widescreen support for the game, we’ll also be setting up a beta testing branch for balancing updates and future content testing. 

Once again, thanks for all of the feedback and helping us to make The Pale Beyond better!

notes.title: The Pale Beyond review: a gripping survival game full of drama and despair
notes.notes:
You know it’s a great turn in The Pale Beyond when only five of your crew are freezing, two have frostbite, and one has scurvy. After all the struggles and dangers I’ve been through trying to keep my ship’s crew alive in the bone-biting cold of the arctic tundra, that’s definitely a success in my book.

It’s easy to describe Bellular Studio’s survival sim as just ‘Frostpunk on a ship’, but in some ways that’s pretty accurate: you’re the leader of a group trying to survive in a harsh frozen wasteland. But it’s also a comparison that falls short in plenty of other ways. Sure, the engine of this survival sim might run the same as Frostpunk’s, but it’s buried deep in a handcrafted hull. With an overarching story that deals with the drama and despair of survival, together with a cast of underdog characters whose personalities and flaws fuel your determination to keep them alive, The Pale Beyond is much more human than its steampunk counterpart.

notes.title: This polar survival management sim is based on real historical horrors
notes.notes: In 2018 a show called The Terror, based on Dan Simmons' novel, told a fictionalized version of the Franklin expedition's doomed search for the northwest passage. Two ships were lost—one of which really was called HMS Terror, surely tempting fate—and their crews never found. The Terror took this true story of a struggle for survival in awful conditions and spiced it with supernatural horror. While I didn't mind the addition of a mystical murder bear, a lot of viewers liked the true-to-history parts so much they said they'd have preferred it without fictional horrors—just the real awfulness of cold, starvation, and lead poisoning from a bad batch of tinned rations... Read more.

notes.title: The Pale Beyond now Verified for Steam Deck ✅
notes.notes:
Hello Readers,

I thought my camera was the latest technology, but I’ve only recently discovered an amazing new device called a ‘Steam Deck’! It’s an incredible handheld machine that lets you play Steam games on it wherever you like.

Doing some research, I’ve discovered that The Pale Beyond is fully compatible with the Steam Deck. Isn’t that amazing? It’s received a green tick, which means a “Verified” status. This means that if you own a Steam Deck, you can enjoy The Pale Beyond anywhere without any hassle.

Doesn’t it look great? I hope I can get some more time to investigate it thoroughly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41484940/d91fbd1d3b555d437971bdc6a119519bf8deda39.jpg[/img]

In addition to this, The Pale Beyond supports Cloud Saves - ideal if you want to play the game on your computer, then continue your adventure during a long ocean voyage on the Steam Deck! I’ve also found out the game features Achievements and Full Controller support as well.

So what does this “Verified” status mean for The Pale Beyond? 
[list]
[*] Is fully functional when using the default controller configuration
[*] Shows Steam Deck controller icons
[*] Features legible in-game interface text on the Steam Deck
[*] Performs well with the Steam Deck on its default graphical configuration
[/list]

[b]On launch day, to find The Pale Beyond on your Steam Deck, [/b]simply press the “Steam” Button on your Steam Deck and select “Library”. The first category, “Great on Deck”, includes all the games you own with the “Verified” status - including The Pale Beyond (as long as you own it!).

notes.title: The Pale Beyond Goes Gold ⚓
notes.notes:
Hello Readers,

Kasha Bellford here - independent photojournalist as part of the expedition to find the Viscount under the leadership of Captain Hunt and First Mate Robin Shaw. I will be logging all of our expeditions and findings as we travel. My first report is that [b]The Pale Beyond has gone gold[/b]!

I’ve read up on it, and that means the game has had platform approval to release. I went to talk to the crew about it, and they certainly seemed excited too. They were shouting things like “Kasha, get off the rigging!” and “Out of my cabin THIS INSTANT!”. I’m glad they’re thrilled by the news as well.

Captain Hunt seems a bit more sombre than the rest of the crew. He puts on a jovial tone, but I know that’s just for show. When I asked him what we’d really expect to find beyond the Pale Passage, he gave me an impish grin and said “Kasha, ,What’s the point of a journey if you don’t get to discover it for yourself?” Then he walked off with that gruff chuckle of his. I’ll definitely be keeping an eye on him.

notes.notes:

Tune in this Thursday for a live chat with Michael and Thomas from Bellular Gaming, the developers of The Pale Beyond. Michael and Thomas will be sitting down and chatting about their inspiration for the game and how they decided to start making games. You can tune into the stream right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/fellowtraveller]here[/url] on our Steam page, playing on loop from December 16.
